newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Edison Mich. Fermi 2 nuke restarts.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Edison Mich. Fermi 2 nuke restarts.

text.p: Detroit Edison Co's 1,116 megawatt (MW) Fermi 2 nuclear generating station began restart after being shut for refueling and maintenance September 27, the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Tuesday.
In its daily plant status report, the Monroe County, Mich., facility was operating at five percent of capacity.
The plant's original startup was pushed back by roughly a week because engineers needed to correct a problem with an indicator light on the reactor's safety release valves.
Detroit Edison is a subsidiary of DTE Energy Corp.
